title: Why Microwaves Don't Heat Food From the Inside
description:
Microwaves don't cook from the inside out, and 2.45 GHz isn't a special "water frequency". Most of the energy is absorbed in the outer 1–2 cm.
Here's why the middle of your leftovers stays cold, what the turntable is for, and why defrosting goes so badly.
